description: This file provides utility functions for mapping statuses and strings to deterministic or themed colors, primarily used in a dashboard for visual distinction of different statuses. It includes functions for generating consistent pastel colors from arbitrary strings and mapping common status labels to color tokens suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: colorFromString(key, { saturation = 55, lightness = 55 } = {})
methods.description: Deterministically generates a pastel HSL color string from an input string, creating distinct hues for different strings while keeping saturation and lightness suitable for dark backgrounds.

methods.name: getStatusColor(status, oc)
methods.description: Maps common status labels to predefined theme colors (primary, success, error, secondary) for consistent visual representation. For unknown labels, it falls back to a deterministic pastel color generated from the string.
